messages:
anya: quick flag  noticed eu-west cost spike when preemptives got nuked and our per-tenant latency-budget binding bounced penalties a lot. thinking: move from per-route immediate penalties to a shared penalty allocator that smooths and redistributes based on capacity + p95 history. rough sketch below.
kevin: curious how "shared" avoids thrashing across tenants? if we rebalance too often we might cause more instability than we solve
anya: plan is windowed smoothing + a capped delta per rebalance. allocator suggests normalized_penalty for each route; tenant explicit floors still win. we only apply deltas up to max_delta_per_rebalance
maria: where does dedicated capacity fit? we can't just redistribute off dedicated pools into shared ones
anya: dedicated pools are not forcibly rebalanced. allocator only suggests for shared/dynamic pools. for dedicated we expose suggestions via metrics and a UI flag; infra makes final decision
suresh: can you paste the pseudo-config we'll use so eng-runtime and sim harness can sync?
anya: sure: ```allocator_window=10m;smoothing=ema(0.2);normalize_by=capacity_units,p95;rebalance_min_interval=60s;max_delta_per_rebalance=0.15;tenant_floor=tenant.min_penalty```
kevin: metrics/alerts thoughts? ops will want guardrails before rollout
maria: require allocator.rebalance_rate, allocator.suggested_vs_applied, and p95_region_delta alerts. trigger canary rollback if p95 increases >15% in 5m or rebalance_rate > 0.05/min
anya: deploy-bot: kicking off a shadow canary to validate sim vs live.
deploy-bot: canary created: canary/allocator/4832106421 shadowing ~2% traffic eu-west + us-central
suresh: for reproducibility, exporter should emit deterministic replay file with states and inputs so runtime can replay a rebalance locally
anya: yep, sim will produce replay.tar.gz with the exact time-series and decisions. runtime will accept replay for local debugging and for CI integration tests
kevin: ops playbook? what are clear rollback triggers and the manual steps?
maria: rollout plan I want: 2w shadow, 1w 25% progressive, 2w 50% then full. rollback if cumulative user p95 increase >10% or customer-facing error ratio >0.5% for >5m. also manual kill switch in console
anya: i'll draft RFC with sim results, playbook, and telemetry tag `allocator_reason` (values: capacity_normalization|p95_correction|tenant_floor) so SRE/CS can query why a penalty changed
suresh: quick ask: include an output sample for the metrics stream so alerting team can author rules without waiting
anya: sample will be in RFC. thanks all :thumbsup:
